description: Returns execution metrics for the project: activeUsers, totalExecutions and failedExecutions as time series ({ value, startTime, endTime }; value is absent when zero). granularity daily covers the last 7 days, weekly aggregates by week. deployment_id narrows the numbers to one deployment. A rising failedExecutions count is the cue to call list_processes with statuses=[FAILED] for the concrete failures. Requires the script.metrics scope.

deployment_id.description: Only count executions of this deployment.

granularity.description: daily = last 7 days per day; weekly = per week.

script_id.description: The script project id — from the Apps Script editor URL (script.google.com/home/projects/<scriptId>/edit) or from create_project output. For standalone projects it doubles as the Drive file id.

name: get_project_metrics
title: Get execution metrics
